items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: and Manzie Johnson was the drummer, and I was the saxophonist.

ctx.x: in the Village, and we got the band together and rehearsed. I don't remember all of the members of the band, but there was Bobby, he was the trumpet player... Bobby Burnet was the trumpet player, Leonard Feather was the pianist, and Manzie Johnson was the drummer, and I was the saxophonist. Now, there's two that I don't remember, one or two. I don't know if it was a five-piece combination or a six-piece combination.
But you probably had a string bass.
